question: Who among the following is NOT related to Apple Inc. as its co-founder?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mark Zuckerberg**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• He launched **Facebook** in **2004** while studying at **Harvard University,** which later became one of the largest social media platforms.
 
• He currently serves as the CEO of **Meta** (formerly Facebook, Inc.), which also owns Instagram, WhatsApp, and Oculus.
 
• Facebook’s headquarters are located in **Menlo Park, California**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ronald Wayne:**

 
 
• He co-founded Apple Inc. in **1976** along with Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak but sold his shares shortly after for $800.
 
• He provided administrative oversight and created the **original Apple logo**.
 
 
 
• **Steve Wozniak:**
 
 
• He co-founded Apple Inc. and was the chief designer of the **Apple I** and **Apple II **computers.
 
• He is known for his contributions to the personal computer revolution in the late **1970s** and early **1980s**.
 
 
 
• **Steve Jobs**:
 
 
• He co-founded Apple Inc. and played a crucial role in the development of products like the **iPhone**, iPad, and Mac computers.
 
• He is recognized for his marketing skills and vision, transforming Apple into a leading technology company.
